title: Service (guests/<guest>/services/<service>/service.yaml)
description: One thing that runs on a guest, managed by a workflow with manages: service. See docs/workflows.md.

links.description: Where people open the service, such as https://vault.example.com/. The Inventory shows them, and an agent checks each one answers. Changing them runs nothing. See docs/uptime.md.

inputs.description: Given to every stage: as variables to an OpenTofu stage, as extra vars to an Ansible one. Validated by the workflow's inputs schema, as { inputs }.

secrets.description: Extra vars filled from the variable store, for the workflow's Ansible stages. Only the steps that run a playbook receive them.

secretFiles.description: Extra vars holding the path of a private file with the store value, for the workflow's Ansible stages.
